desc: Bazzalan's Satyr Fur: Bazzalan's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a bare chest, shaggy dark brown goat-fur legs like a satyr's, long fur tufts at the forearms, and a thin silver-studded belt
Fang Druid Leathers: green snakeskin leathers with lighter scale patterns, a leaf-and-fang belt, Druid of the Fang style

VanCleef's Garb: Edwin VanCleef's armour: dark navy blue leather with gold swirling filigree trim, big flared layered pauldrons edged in gold sticking out past the shoulders, a high layered collar, broad gold-trimmed cuffs, buckled straps down the chest
Arugal's Robe: a purple archmage's robe with silver trim and pale stars, a high collar, Archmage Arugal's
Twilight Robes: deep violet Twilight's Hammer cultist robes with gold trim and a glowing eye sigil on the chest
Prison Stripes: a black and cream striped prison jumpsuit, a little worn, with a number patch on the chest
Mekgineer Overalls: blue gnome engineer overalls over a cream shirt, brass buttons, tools in the pockets, a few oil stains

Charlga's Dress: Charlga Razorflank's look from World of Warcraft Classic (a quilboar priestess): a teal-turquoise dress with crimson zigzag and triangle trim patterns, short wide sleeves and a darker teal striped hem
Bloodmage Robe: a crimson Scarlet Crusade bloodmage robe with a dark red sash and cream trim, a fiery orange lining

Doan's Robes: Arcanist Doan's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a long red-orange Scarlet mage robe with purple trim, tall violet-edged shoulder panels, a wide purple sash, and an open front showing a pale grey undershirt

Herod's Armour: Herod's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a bare muscular chest, one big red-and-gold shoulder pad with white spikes, red plate gauntlets, a red belt with a gold buckle, and red plate legs with gold swirls
Scarlet Robe: a white and gold high inquisitor's robe with a red Scarlet Crusade emblem and red trim, High Inquisitor Whitemane's

Amnennar's Robes: Amnennar the Coldbringer's look from World of Warcraft Classic: long purple lich robes with gold trim, heavy chains draped across the chest, gold claw-shaped shoulder pieces, and blue crystal gems at the hem

Archaedas's Stone Robes: Archaedas's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a long robe of carved grey stone with big stone shoulder plates, stone bands wrapping the arms like chains, and a long stone tabard down the front
Sandfury Wraps: jungle troll sand-coloured cloth wraps with brown leather straps, bone beads and bright red, orange and yellow feathers

Theradras's Gold: Princess Theradras's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a golden band top with a big green gem in the middle, gold arm bands with green stones, and a short gold-and-yellow fringed skirt; lots of bare skin
Thane's Mail: dwarven steel chainmail with a bronze-trimmed breastplate and a fur collar
Lordaeron Royal Tabard: a dark, worn Lordaeron tabard over chainmail, its blue and gold faded and stained with sickly green plague
Explorer's Vest: a khaki Explorers' League field vest with many pockets over a cream shirt with rolled sleeves, a brown belt
Emerald Dragonscale: green dragonscale armour with pale green highlights and leafy vines, from the Emerald Dream

Emperor's Robes: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan's look from World of Warcraft Classic: black robes with a big white-and-red front panel, wide angular red-and-gold shoulder pads, gold-trimmed black sleeves with ornate silver patterns, and a gold-banded belt piece

Omokk's War Harness: Highlord Omokk's look from World of Warcraft Classic: big red-and-black spiked shoulder pads, a black iron chest plate hung on chains across the bare belly, black-and-red banded bracers with grey fur, and a red-and-black armoured kilt

Drakkisath's Scales: General Drakkisath's look from World of Warcraft Classic: orange-and-black dragonkin scale armour with a tall flame-painted orange-red war banner rising behind the back and orange bat-like wings

Alzzin's Wild Fur: Alzzin the Wildshaper's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a bare chest, shaggy golden-olive goat-fur legs like a satyr's, long golden fur tufts at the forearms, and a thin studded belt
Highborne Robes: elegant deep blue Highborne elven robes with silver trim and pale blue arcane patterns, Prince Tortheldrin's
Ogre King's Furs: the Gordok ogre king's purple royal cloak with a thick fur collar, crude gold chains and a big gold belt buckle, King Gordok's

Gandling's Robes: Darkmaster Gandling's look from World of Warcraft Classic: a long dark grey-black robe with a wide blue front panel, angular silver-trimmed shoulder pads, and a silver belt with a skull buckle
Dreadlord Mantle: dark purple dreadlord armour with black spiked pauldrons and a high collar, faint fel green glow, Balnazzar's
Death Knight Plate: Baron Rivendare's dark grey death knight plate with skull pauldrons and pale blue glowing trim

Onyxia Onesie: a cute homemade black dragon onesie costume, like a fan-made Onyxia costume: soft black plush with a big pale cream belly panel, stitched seams and sewn-on patches, a row of soft felt spikes down the shoulders, big floppy felt bat wings sticking out wide behind the shoulders and a long stuffed tail curling out to one side; just the body suit (no hood, no second head)
Barrowmoon Robe: a deep violet druid of the moon robe with pale lavender moon and leaf patterns and silver trim
Wild Bark Armor: armour of living tree bark with green leaves and moss growing on it, a vine belt
